reason: The two methods are functionally equivalent for all possible byte[] inputs: they both iterate over the length of the second argument and compare corresponding elements, returning false on the first mismatch and true if all compared elements match. Any case that causes a NullPointerException in one method (e.g., a null second argument or a second argument longer than the first) also causes a NullPointerException in the other. Therefore no concrete separating input exists.
